name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Technician goes with at least one of Anders or Forge.
Dasari, Navigator, and Forge belong to different colonists.
Okafor goes with neither Geologist nor Drift.
Okafor, Technician, and Helix belong to different colonists.
